# @magpie-community/opencode-cloudflare-workers-ai-auth

> Cloudflare Workers AI provider plugin for magpie (and OpenCode 1.x) — sign in
> with your own Cloudflare API token and use `@cf/*` models as an agent provider.

An agent setting up Cloudflare Workers AI inside magpie or OpenCode queries this
for: plugin install (git-first, no npm needed), the token permission shape
(**Account → Workers AI → Edit**, optional **Account Settings → Read** for plan
info), model naming `cloudflare-workers-ai/@cf/<org>/<model>`, live model
discovery from models.dev (28+ models, paid ones flagged), the daily
**10,000 Neurons** free allowance, and which frontier models additionally need
Workers Paid or prepaid AI Gateway credits.

- Install: `magpie plugin add github:Guislabert/magpie-cloudflare-workers-ai`
- Docs: https://github.com/Guislabert/magpie-cloudflare-workers-ai
- License: MIT (Copyright 2026 Guislabert)
- Not affiliated with or endorsed by Cloudflare; uses the public REST API
  (`api.cloudflare.com/client/v4*/ai/*`) with the user's own API token.
